messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in asia-southeast1 — GCP returning QUOTA_EXCEEDED (region-level). Observed sustained queue growth on inference-service-prod (embedding and gen routes). Severity: P1. Initial detection: increased 5xx rate for embeddings and token generation, queue length ~3x baseline. Thread opened 5209876543

oncall-mike: I'm on it, joining the bridge now. Please drop any immediate observations here.

sre-anna: saw the spike at ~09:12 UTC. Autoscaler attempted to allocate 24x T4s and got 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED from GCE API. Errors in autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z autoscaler manager: requestVMs(24) -> FAILED: QuotaError: Quota exceeds limit for RESOURCE_TYPE=GCE_GPUS region=asia-southeast1
```

infra-josh: confirming quotas — project redwood-prod has regional GPU limit T4=32, currently at 32. No spare capacity in that quota bucket. Warm pools are in us-central1, can't scale asia region.

support-lee: incoming customer reports: 2 high-priority tickets for embedding API returning 503s and spikes in latency. Marked as impacted.

product-sara: what's customer impact scope? enterprise customers only or broader?

support-lee: both enterprise and some PLG customers on embeddings; error spike correlates with heavy batch embedding jobs from a few accounts.

oncall-mike: Triage plan (short):
- Failover critical enterprise traffic to eu-west1 pool (compatible models)
- Open/esc GCP quota increase (urgent case)
- Throttle/backoff batch jobs (reduce per-job GPU demand) via rate-limits
- If needed, provision temporary capacity on AWS ap-southeast-1 as hot backup
I'll coordinate the bridge and customer comms.

sre-anna: starting controlled reroute for model=open-embed-3, 10% to eu-west1 to verify. I'll watch error rate and queue.

infra-josh: runbook step executed:
```
# quick check
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-prod
# returned quotas: GPUs (T4) limit=32, usage=32, remaining=0 -> QUOTA_EXCEEDED on new allocations
```

oncall-mike: @infra-josh can we request GPUs in another project/fallback account as emergency?

infra-josh: we can, but cross-project provisioning requires IAM & network peering for storage/keys. Faster option: spin up AWS fleet with A10g for non-critical workloads to free GCP for inference. Starting AMI bake for inference image now. ETA ~12m.

ops-bot: Note added to incident: GCP support case created (12345678) — escalation requested.

customer-success-raj: drafting customer status update: very short note that we are experiencing region quota issues, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m. Will post to customers once we have confirmation of routing.

support-lee: ticket#12456 updated: linked to this incident. Customer on seat-of-pants workaround: retry with exponential backoff.

oncall-mike: reroute command going live: pushing to routing service to bias enterprise-tagged traffic to eu-west1. Monitor propagation.

sre-anna: canary results: reroute 10% -> eu-west1 dropped 5xxs for that slice. Latency up ~90-120ms for eu-west1 but errors improved. Moving to 40% now.

ops-bot: /reroute model=open-embed-3 region=eu-west1 weight=40% by oncall-mike executed

infra-josh: AWS fleet spin-up: 8x A10g nodes started but one node failing due to Containerd version mismatch. Fixing image, rebuilding container, ETA 9m. If successful, we'll register nodes with inference pool and mark them for non-critical jobs.

oncall-mike: action: move background training/batch embedding jobs off GCP to AWS once healthy, to free up GPU quota for realtime inference. Assigning to infra-josh and sre-anna.

product-sara: prioritize enterprise traffic for failover; PLG traffic can be degraded / rate-limited. Need messaging coordination with CS.

sre-anna: GCP case update: acknowledged, but request routed to product quota team — no immediate ETA. We have TAM pinged for expedited review. Case 12345678.

customer-success-raj: initial status posted to impacted customers. Will prepare follow-up if situation persists beyond 30m.

support-lee: error volume trending down as reroute increases; still seeing bursts but fewer total 5xxs. Keeping tickets updated.

oncall-mike: decision point: if AWS capacity healthy, migrate noncritical load to AWS and hold GCP for enterprise inference. Otherwise continue progressive reroute.

infra-josh: AWS nodes ready and registered with pool. Did a smoke test of model pull & KV cache warmup. All green. Will cutover noncritical workloads now.

sre-anna: noncritical jobs moved -> GPU demand on GCP dropped ~28%. Queue length decreasing. Errors trending to baseline. Reroute weight set to 60% eu-west1 for enterprise slice until quotas resolved.

ops-bot: Incident timeline entry: 09:12 detection -> 09:20 reroute started -> 09:30 AWS backup healthy -> 09:38 noncritical migrate started -> 09:45 queue decreasing. Case 12345678 open.

oncall-mike: Customer impact: reduced; enterprise SLAs being preserved via eu-west1 failover. PLG/low-tier customers may experience degraded throughput. CS/Support coordinated.

support-lee: adding notes to tickets and tagging customers that were routed to eu-west1 (some may observe latency increases).

oncall-mike: Handoff plan: I'll hand to night oncall @oncall-ana at 5209876800. Handoff notes:
- Case 12345678 with GCP (no ETA). TAM contacted.
- AWS backup available, noncritical jobs moved.
- Reroute weight: enterprise=open-embed-3 -> eu-west1 60%.
- Monitor metrics: inference_queue_length, model_error_rate, gpu_util_per_region. Alert thresholds: queue>1000 or 5xx_rate>3% resume immediate paging.
- Links: bridge: https://meet.example.com/bridge/5209876543 runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gpu-quota

oncall-ana: ack, taking oncall. I'll monitor for 2h and escalate if quotas not resolved. Please leave any sticky notes in thread.

sre-anna: leaving sticky: if quotas still blocked after 2h, prepare plan to globally reduce default batch sizes and enforce stricter request rate-limits for PLG traffic; runbook section 'degraded-mode' has commands.

ops-bot: Incident status updated to MONITORED.

oncall-mike: thanks team — handing off now. I'll remain available for questions.

oncall-ana: thanks - acked. Will update if anything changes.
